summary: Part 4 of the Revibe 2.1 Fulfillment App (KAM) video (15:24-18:13). The trainer walks through the Revibe - Fulfillment App (AppSheet web app) tab by tab: Inventory exits (exit types and return reasons, grouped by Type, filtered by supplier), Stock control, Invalids to fix, Charge inventory, Box inventory, Packaging request, Fulfillment expenses, Shipments, and Supplier inventory (bulk select, Drop -2%). He then gives the payment terms for fulfillment and points to the fulfillment video made for sellers. All 28 frames listed in the pack were opened. Several frame references in the pack were one or two frames off; the frame ids below were re-assigned from the frame content.

asr_fixes.basis: Screen frame t00924.jpg shows the app title 'Revibe - Fulfillment App'.
Sidebar and page title on frame t00987.jpg read 'Invalids to fix'.

unclear.issue: 'is like a {special?} operation led by Revive' starts mid-explanation. The pack has no earlier context, so the subject of this sentence is unclear.
'we always indicate also the AMEA and the {other?} help' has no screen equivalent. The term 'AMEA' cannot be confirmed; the Order help column is a possible but unconfirmed match.
Trainer says sellers can 'request for return in bulk', but no return button appears on frames t01035, t01043 or t01046. Only the Drop -2% button is visible on screen.

The payment-terms sentence is partly unclear: 'orders shipped on the past seven days and packaging requests'. The 'seven days' figure comes only from speech and is not shown on screen. It is unclear whether packaging requests are part of the basis.

Box inventory and Fulfillment expenses pages are dimmed in the frames, so column names and item names are only partly legible. Their purpose is only partly explained ('something something else', 'this is not really used').
Narration 'fulfillment expenses this is' is cut off; the purpose of the Fulfillment expenses page is not stated.
'sellers can go here' does not say which view 'here' refers to. Supplier inventory is the likely view, but Shipments was on screen just before.

Frame-to-narration timing is approximate. 'Stock control' (16:18) and 'invalid to fix' (16:24) are spoken while the previous view is still on screen: Stock control appears at 16:20 and Invalids to fix at 16:27. Frame ids in the pack for these screens were one frame off.
Colours of the Inventory days dots (red, yellow, green) on Charge inventory and Supplier inventory are not explained on screen or in speech.
'{if?}' and '{bulk?}' markers on the aging-return sentence mean the trigger wording is low-confidence; the definition is taken from the unmarked clause only.

outdated.signal: In the visible Packaging request rows, 'Required at' dates run from 5/19/2026 to 7/1/2026 (before today, 2026-10-22) with Stage 'Sent'. These look like past deadlines.

privacy.what: Shipments 'Created by' column shows seller account email addresses in full (for example smartreachtrading@gmail.com and zabmobiletrading@gmail.com). One row shows an internal Revibe staff email (yahia.elbellaj@revibe.me). This column should not be shown to sellers.
Packaging request rows show seller business names, AWB numbers and tracking links. These are business and shipment data, not personal data, but they link to a seller's shipments.
Inventory exits rows show device IMEI numbers and tracking IDs. These are device and shipment identifiers, not personal data.
